title: Tech Note: JSON Definition Tool for Dynamic Forms
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: form object JSON schemas (list box, web area, Write Pro, View Pro, etc.)

historical_commentary.text: Dynamic Forms defined via JSON remain a supported 4D feature and the general mechanics (Open form window / OBJECT SET SUBFORM consuming a JSON/object form definition) are unchanged in concept, though 4D's official documentation for Dynamic Form JSON schemas has since expanded significantly, making this note's exhaustive per-object catalog a useful but no longer sole reference.
related_updates: 4D's official Dynamic Form documentation has grown substantially since v17, covering more form object types and properties than catalogued here
the JSON/object-based dynamic form generation mechanism itself is unchanged and still current in 4D today
Project Mode (v17-18+) forms are still stored as JSON on disk, making familiarity with this JSON schema even more broadly useful than in Design Mode/binary-structure days
